text:
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> INC-2026-8472. Severity: P1. Symptom: high GPU queue growth for 'text-gen-prod' pool. Acknowledged by Maya R.

Maya R: picking this up — seeing large queue backlog and elevated evictions on several nodes. Paging oncall.

Sam K: on it. initial checks: autoscaler reports at max_nodes for the pool. metric: pending_requests ~ 3.2k, avg_latency 1.8s -> spiking.

Jen L: logs show repeating driver restarts on node gnode-7a (Xid 13 / CUDA 700 error). nvidia-smi shows GPU memory fragmentation and odd processes.

Ryan T: confirmed. `dmesg` tail from gnode-7a: "NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:03): 13, pid=2211, gpu=0` repeating.

Aisha S: customer-impact: some large customers report timeouts on embeddings and generation API. Support tickets rolling in. Estimated affected requests ~2% of overall but heavy for tail latency.

Maya R: immediate plan: 1) take gnode-7a out of rotation, 2) trigger a targeted restart of the driver on other nodes showing early errors, 3) request temporary autoscaler soft-limit bump from infra.

Sam K: doing step 1 -> `kubectl annotate node gnode-7a cordon=yes` and removing from pool. Removing will take ~30s for in-flight drains.

Ops Bot: Node gnode-7a cordoned by Sam K. Evicting pods: 24 pods scheduled for migration.

Jen L: driver restart on gnode-7b and gnode-7c (flapping but not crashed). Using `systemctl restart nvidia-driver` then watch.

Ryan T: running `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` and checking for ECC errors. Memory stats look noisy on 7c.

Maya R: autoscaler config shows max_nodes=80 for the GPU pool. We're at 78 currently. Infra has a quota cap on the project at 85 but autoscaler hard-coded 80. I'll ping infra.

Maya R: @Infra Bot escalate: request temporary autoscaler upper-bound=90 for pool text-gen-prod for 60m.

Infra Bot: Escalation ticket created -> INFRA-6218. Notifying infra ops. ETA for response: ~7 minutes.

PagerDuty Bot: INC-2026-8472: acknowledged by Maya R, assigned to Sam K.

Sam K: post-cordon, queue dropped 12% already. But we're still seeing per-node evictions and OOMs on older driver kernel combos. Kernel 5.15 + driver 525 on a few nodes. Could be a scheduler/regression with recent driver roll.

Jen L: recommendation: fallback route — route low-priority traffic to cheapest model (cpu or small-quantized) to relieve GPU pressure. Can we flip routing?

Maya R: yes. Initiating route config change: `route set text-gen-prod low_priority->cpu-fallback` on all regions. This is a graceful fallback for non-SLA requests.

Ops Bot: Route change deployed to gateways. Approx 15% of traffic will shift to cpu-fallback.

Aisha S: notify Support: prepare customer comms for customers hitting timeouts. Suggest status page update and mention active mitigation.

Maya R: Support notified. Draft for status: "We are experiencing GPU driver instability leading to increased latency and errors for a subset of generation requests. Mitigations in progress: removing affected nodes, driver restarts, and routing low-priority traffic to fallback models."
